description: How well ARUON holds a place for one report: band full_data (24-hour clock where sla_hours is set), area_scan, zip_only or unknown, with the reason. The answer the order page reads. Whether an order can be paid at once depends on the report: market_scan, scout_shortlist_founding and screen_parcel go to checkout only where the band is full_data; tower_sheet and site_search only where area_scan is true (the ordered ring is loaded), whatever the band; market_report on any US ZIP, whatever the band; tower_targets never: an analyst always confirms scope first. Anywhere else an analyst confirms scope before anything is charged; ok=false means the place could not be read. Even on held ground an order can still go to scope review, so create_order's status is the final word.

inputSchema.description: ONE place: state + county_fips, lat + lng, zip, or address.

address.description: A street address (geocoded once; address lookups are limited per connection).

sku.description: The report the coverage is read for.
